what_this_is:
The PR-08 gate document for GEOM_TOL, in TWO SECTIONS. 

SECTION 1, THE CONTRACT, is the keys named in `contract_fields`. It is committed BEFORE the measurement and no measurement may alter it. PR-08 §4 step 2 requires GEOM_TOL and EST_DRIFT_P95 to be measured with THE SAME segmenter, and §6 subtracts them — GEOM_TOL - EST_DRIFT_P95 is the tolerance the restyled corpus is held to — so the subtraction is arithmetic only if both sides ran the same detector, the same segmenter, the same prompt, the same thresholds and the same box rule on the same pixel grid. Until this file existed the only thing either artifact recorded about the segmenter was a NAME, and two runs can share a name while disagreeing about every number below. It is written before the measurement on purpose: a mask method chosen (or quietly adjusted) after seeing the number it produces is the failure the committed style partition exists to prevent, and 'we used the same segmenter' is not a checkable claim unless the claim was written down first. The `segmenter` block is a verbatim copy of scripts/estimators/apple_sam2.py's SEGMENTER_CONTRACT, which is itself Cosmos-Transfer2.5's own operating point read off cosmos_transfer2/_src/transfer2/auxiliary/sam2/sam2_model.py (cluster copy, 2026-08-22) — these are the GENERATOR's numbers, not ours, which is the entire point of §4 step 2.

SECTION 2, THE MEASUREMENT, is the keys named in `measurement_fields`. They are null here because NEITHER NUMBER HAS BEEN MEASURED YET: this file commits the method, not the result, and in this state it does not license generation. scripts/measure_geom_tol.py writes its full artifact over this document when GEOM_TOL is measured (this path is its default --out and its --merge target) and fills `geom_tol_px` / `geom_tol_source`; scripts/measure_est_drift.py measures EST_DRIFT_P95 into configs/transfer25/pr08_est_drift.json and `est_drift_p95_px` / `est_drift_source` / `est_drift_estimator_name` / `gate_margin_px` stay null until it is carried across. CARRY IT WITH `measure_geom_tol.py --carry-est-drift configs/transfer25/pr08_est_drift.json`, NOT WITH A TEXT EDITOR. `est_drift_estimator_name` is the JOIN KEY: PR-08 §4 step 2 requires both halves to come from the SAME segmenter, run_g0_gates._ca_mask_method_name is the consumer that checks it, and a number carried across without the name leaves that assertion permanently unanswerable — which costs every G0b run its gate qualification, so the gate can never say yes. The two are therefore written together or neither is written (measure_geom_tol.refuse_unnamed_est_drift), and --carry-est-drift additionally refuses a disqualified or null measurement, a segmenter name that disagrees with this document's mask_method, a segmenter whose parameters disagree field for field, and a different pixel grid. `geom_tol_px` and measure_geom_tol's own `GEOM_TOL_px` are written to the SAME value on purpose: scripts/run_g0_gates.py `_first_present` refuses a document that states one quantity under two spellings that disagree, and a null left beside a measured number is exactly that disagreement.

HOW SECTION 1 SURVIVES SECTION 2 BEING WRITTEN. measure_geom_tol.merge_committed_contract() runs before anything is written to this path: it compares the `segmenter` block on disk field for field against the SEGMENTER_CONTRACT of the adapter it just ran, REFUSES the whole run (exit 2, nothing written, no sidecar) on any disagreement, and otherwise copies every key in `contract_fields` forward verbatim into the artifact it writes. It also refuses to write this tracked path at all when no contract is found here — restore it from git rather than letting a measurement invent one. measure_est_drift.cross_check_geom_tol() then finds the same block on both sides (top-level `segmenter`, or mask_method.params.segmenter, which records what the adapter actually ran with) and disqualifies its own run on any disagreement.
